latHint: Think a subcontinent in the radio code - not a place to stay.
pivHint: A HOTEL is a place to sleep - but in the radio code, H is HOTEL, so what word is I?
winText: Roger. HOTEL was the pivot - a place to stay to the code word INDIA.
lossText: INDIA - code word for I. HOTEL was the pivot: a HOTEL stay to H, then INDIA.
